resources.string: A PCAP file is created only when you start the advanced packet capture control. It can contain raw packet payload bytes and is not redacted. Share it only with people you trust.
Detection check downloads shared statistics from this address to compare your results. Nothing is uploaded.
Deletes downloaded community statistics. Your check history stays.
Accept only IP addresses. The proxy rejects requests that ask it to resolve a domain name.
Send data in the first packet of outgoing connections to save a round trip. Some networks drop these packets.
